Hi, I've looked at many of your maps, and some pages. For one thing, if you could direct me to the page that gives a reason why Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa, etc. Were annexed by America that would be helpful.

And second thing, on all of your maps, I notice Tonga is not even named. If it is part of the US, well that sucks. However If it isn't, it would be nice to see an Oceanic Nation still independent!

Peace Out, -Firestorm<ac_metadata title="Tonga"> </ac_metadata>
